title: Research Strategy
goal: Compare three research approaches for a constrained prototype and identify which approach should be investigated first.
context: The human has a limited implementation window and wants a transparent comparison rather than an unexplained recommendation.
constraints: Prefer approaches supported by the supplied evidence.
Surface evidence conflicts instead of hiding them.
Preserve uncertainty where the supplied material is insufficient.
The result must remain inspectable by a human.
